notes.summary: A haunted woodland of silent pale trees. It plays like Bewitched Woods, with the Creaking closing in on whichever side keeps attacking.

sections.heading: Type power
lines: Fairy moves are 1.5× stronger, hit Steel super effectively and Dark neutrally.
Dark moves are 1.3× stronger and hit Fairy neutrally.
Mimicry, Camouflage and Terrain Pulse use the Fairy type. Nature Power becomes Dazzling Gleam.
Secret Power can cause sleep, poison or paralysis.

sections.heading: Bewitched Woods rules
lines: Grounded Grass Pokémon recover 1/16 of their HP each turn. Sleeping Pokémon lose 1/16 each turn.

Hex, Mystical Fire and Spirit Break are 1.5× stronger. Aurora Beam, Bubble Beam, Charge Beam, Flash Cannon, Hyper Beam, Ice Beam, Magical Leaf, Psybeam and Signal Beam are 1.4× stronger. Dark Pulse, Moonblast and Night Daze are 1.2× stronger.
Forest's Curse also curses the target. Magic Powder also puts the target to sleep. Strength Sap also lowers Special Attack. Moonlight heals 75%.
Grass Whistle, Poison Powder, Sleep Powder and Stun Spore have 85% accuracy.

Effect Spore triggers 60% of the time. Flower Gift is always active and Flower Veil protects every Pokémon. Natural Cure also heals status each turn. Pastel Veil removes its holder's Fairy weaknesses. Power Spot lifts a partner's move power 1.5×. Prankster can affect Dark types.
Shelter halves Fairy damage to its user.

sections.heading: Creaking Distraction
lines: Each side has its own counter from 0 to 3.
A damaging move that connects adds 1 to its side's counter, at most once per side per turn (also in doubles).
A status move that succeeds resets its side's counter to 0. Using one does not give back that turn's damaging tick.
At 3, every active Pokémon on that side loses 40% of its maximum HP, even through Protect or a Substitute, and the counter returns to 0.
Attack too long and the Creakings catch you; stop to use a status move and they freeze.

sections.heading: Magical Seed
lines: Raises the holder's Defense by 6 stages and petrifies it.
